target.role: Head of the Canada Risk Office

summary: Risk governance and model-oversight professional with ~7 years of experience in independent review, issue escalation, and controls remediation, pursuing the Head of the Canada Risk Office mandate at Capital One Canada. Holds delegated sign-off authority over institutional analytics ($5-25bn per engagement) within a formal model governance framework, escalates and remediates control gaps, and closed a governance audit finding through a controlled Python migration. Cross-functional coordination experience spans finance, risk, IT, and actuarial stakeholders on regulatory transformation programs (IFRS 17/IFRS 9). CFA charterholder; dual MSc.
core_skills: Process Management, Improvement & Python Automation of Manual Workflows

sections.heading: Risk Governance, Oversight & Independent Challenge
bullets: Holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement (~$50bn+ cumulative), applying independent review before production release.
Serves on the model governance committee, contributing to methodology review, documentation and benchmarking standards, and model-performance assessment for client-delivered analytics.
Operates within a formal model governance framework, validating assumptions and economic defensibility to documentation standards consistent with SR 11-7 and OSFI E-23 expectations.

sections.heading: Issue Escalation, Remediation & Control Closure
bullets: Escalates outputs lacking mathematical or economic defensibility and serves as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues, interfacing with clients' Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders.

Held a client release for 48 hours after portfolio sensitivities passed internal checks but failed economic review, traced the defect to a curve-calibration edge case, escalated to product owners and the client's Head of Risk, and embedded the fix in permanent validation tests.

Re-engineered a spreadsheet-driven valuation workflow into a logged, version-controlled Python pipeline, running two shadow-mode reconciliation cycles before cutover and closing the open governance audit item.

sections.heading: Risk Metrics, Reporting & Process Improvement
bullets: Prepares analytical summaries for senior stakeholders on interest-rate exposure, scenario impacts, and balance-sheet sensitivities, translating quantitative output into committee-ready narratives.
Led design of an enterprise multi-asset cash flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios, with time-bucketed liquidity metrics from T+1 through multi-year horizons.

Built agentic AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) automating code generation, validation scaffolding, and anomaly detection, reducing development cycle time an estimated 30-40% on comparable modules.

Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms migrating to the PFaroe DB and PFaroe PM analytics platforms; validated model outputs post-deployment.

Acted as technical liaison between client investment teams and product owners, scoping requirements into development requests and completing migration of all assigned accounts off the legacy Calypso platform.

roles.title: Senior Consultant, IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients, aligning new regulatory requirements with system implementation and reporting frameworks.

Advised actuarial, IT, finance, and program management functions on IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 adoption; contributed to governance documentation and regulatory compliance readiness processes for financial institutions.
Coordinated across actuarial, finance, IT, risk, and PM teams on milestone delivery and implementation materials.
Delivered ALM studies for Canadian and international pension funds and institutional investors, analyzing funding ratios, duration mismatch, and long-term balance-sheet risk exposures.

Designed stochastic risk-management frameworks tailored to client mandates and built economic scenario generators used to stress test funding volatility and interest-rate exposure under base and stressed environments.
Led onboarding and the ALM study for a three-plan university pension merger on a three-person team, developing and validating the model capturing all funding policy dynamics.
Presented study findings and allocation recommendations to investment committees at Canadian pension fund clients on-site.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) - Western University, 2016
